extensionName.message: Cross-Origin Proxy - CORS & API Environment Switcher
extensionName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and browser UI. Chrome enforces <=75 characters; keywords live here only, while the in-app HeaderBar uses the short brand name from locales/en/common.json.

extensionShortName.description: Short brand name used for the toolbar tooltip. Must match locales/en/common.json extensionName (guarded by tests) so store keywords never leak into browser UI.

extensionDescription.message: Proxy API calls to FAT/UAT/PROD, no code or CORS changes. Rewrite URLs/headers/responses, mock, delay, block, retry, WebSocket.
extensionDescription.description: Short description used in store search results and the detail summary. Chrome enforces <=132 codepoints (hard upload failure above that); currently 127, deliberately leaving headroom so the text is not truncated in search results.

commandToggleProxy.description: Keyboard shortcut description for toggling the proxy
